passerby.emotions: female 82 yo, speaks loud, screechy and grumbly

dialogOption.texten: 911, what's your emergency?
Hello? Hello! Anybody there?!
Ma'am you've reached 911 what's your emergency?
Sir, there is plenty of water here... damn it...
{WHAT HAPPENED?} What happened ma'am?
What? Speak up, I have problems with hearing.
I asked: what happened?
I just told you, there is water everywhere.
{IS A PIPE BROKEN?} Where is it coming from? Do you have something wrong with your pipes?
Pardon? Pipes? No!
{ARE YOU SURE?} Are you sure?
Yeah! When the shaking started I hid under the table, you know. A very solid one, made out of wood not like the ones they make these days.
{WHAT ABOUT THE WATER?}Ok, but what about the water?
It flows from the top and on the side. Almost like a river. Maybe some pipe cracked? Or maybe it's coming from the house that started collapsing when the shaking began, a bit higher.
{HOW MUCH WATER?}How much water is there?

I don't know about the basement, but it keeps flowing down there, right through the middle of my room! And there is mud too! I live downstairs where it's flat, so it all stays here. Sometimes even when it's raining... but now...
{TURN OFF BREAKER BOX} Ok ma'am you're gonna have to shut down your breaker box.
The breaker box ma'am, so you don't get electrocuted.
But we don't have power at the moment. Nothing's working! When it was shaking, it must have damaged the cables or something. It happens sometimes.
{I INSIST} I insist you turn off the breaker box.
But I told you that...
They could restore power at any moment. If water hits the electricity you could get electrocuted.
Get what?
Oh... ok, what should I do then?
{SHUT OFF BREAKER BOX}Shut off your breaker box.
Alright, where are those?
Usually they are in a box near the entrance to the building.
Ah, I know I know, I'm not THAT old.
Of course not.
Can you send someone over anyway? I can't sit here all day wet and without electricity. That's unbearable...
{I'LL SEND SOMEONE} I will send a team as soon as I can.
Ok, but better be quick. The water is cold.
{AS SOON AS IT POSSIBLE}As soon as I can get them there ma'am.
What about the water?
{WHERE?} Where are you calling from? Could you please give me your address?
It's [[ADDRESS]]
At 342 Columbus Avenue
At 135 Oak street
At 89 7th street
Will you do something about this water?

reportElement.texten: The operator convinced the caller to turn off a breaker box, which prevented from electrocution.
The caller was electrocuted. The operator should have instructed the caller to turn off a breaker box.
